story.summaryZh: 兴奋的周末，驾驶GT3赛车参赛，有起有落，团队学到很多。对克里斯在赛后受到的仇恨和骚扰表示不满。

story.originalTitle: Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. I also feel I ne...
story.summaryEn:
Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. 
I also feel I need to speak up about the hate and harassment Chris has received after the race. Everyone can have their opinions about what happened on track, but these personal attacks are not okay. Chris had a really strong stint and mistakes can happen. 
There’s no place for this kind of abuse in our sport or anywhere else.
detailZh:
兴奋的周末！很高兴驾驶我们的GT3赛车在波尔蒂芒参赛。有起有落，但作为团队，我们学到很多。
我也觉得有必要站出来谈谈克里斯在赛后所受到的仇恨和骚扰。每个人都可以对赛道上发生的事情有自己的看法，但这些个人攻击是不恰当的。
克里斯的表现非常出色，错误是会发生的。
在我们的运动或任何地方都不应该有这种虐待行为。
detailEn:
Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. 
I also feel I need to speak up about the hate and harassment Chris has received after the race. Everyone can have their opinions about what happened on track, but these personal attacks are not okay. Chris had a really strong stint and mistakes can happen. 
There’s no place for this kind of abuse in our sport or anywhere else.

At least we got a podium. Our pace and consistency weren’t where we wanted it to be, lots to learn from.
Great to see so much support out here this weekend. Thank you Austin 🙌
